exposure: trial of labor after cesarean delivery
Trial of labor after cesarean delivery (TOLAC)
outcome: Successful vaginal birth after cesarean delivery (VBAC)
cohort: 9888 parturients with 1 previous cesarean delivery, of which 7473 attempted a TOLAC, from a 12-year period in a tertiary referral center
finding: A machine-learning model incorporating maternal and fetal features was able to predict successful VBAC with good accuracy, potentially aiding in decision-making and reducing cesarean delivery rates.
mod_finding: This study investigated the feasibility of using machine learning to predict successful vaginal birth after cesarean delivery (VBAC).
